criteria.requirement: Extend actual flask routes CLI with --format table|json (default table), --endpoint exact name and --blueprint registered-name prefix including nested blueprints. JSON is one versioned object {schema:1,routes:[...]}, including endpoint/rule/sorted full methods/host/subdomain/defaults/automatic_options, honoring sort and empty apps/filters without terminal prose. Convert bounded native JSON defaults without executing opaque repr; unknown values use {$type: class_name}. Preserve ordinary table output, existing --all-methods and matching order semantics; use actual url_map metadata and do not invoke views.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
